system.description:
Protects the character from transformation, displacement, or nullification effects. Grants a bonus to resist certain abilities and includes minor armor protection against insidious attacks.

  • Level 1: +2 Stat roll bonus when resisting effects
  • Level 2: +4 Stat roll bonus when resisting effects
  • Level 3: +6 Stat roll bonus when resisting effects
  • Level 4: +8 Stat roll bonus when resisting effects
  • Level 5: +10 Stat roll bonus when resisting effects
  • Level 6: +12 Stat roll bonus when resisting effects
